en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a curving road descending between rocky outcrops toward a coastal inlet or bay. In the middle distance are fields, a shoreline with small buildings and piers, and low forested hills under a partly cloudy sky. The caption at the bottom left identifies the scene as Uddevalla, Skeppsviken. A small logo and publisher credit appear in the lower right corner.
